description: Time zone converter — Convert a time between IANA time zones (one to many, up to 10) with weekday and UTC offsets, or get the current time anywhere. Pass optional ?time= (ISO or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM), ?from= and ?to= (comma-separated). Price: $0.001 USDC (Base, via x402).

from.description: IANA zone of the given time, default UTC

time.description: optional time to convert, default now

name: time_convert
